manaNeeded: {4}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Restoration Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.
